problem.title: Recover a Binary Tree from Depth-Encoded Preorder Traversal
problem.problemStatement: Given a preorder traversal of a binary tree where the depth of each node is encoded in the traversal, reconstruct the original binary tree.
problem.input: • The first line contains the depth-encoded preorder traversal.
problem.output: • Print the reconstructed tree in the required traversal format.
